# Mnemo

> Mnemo is vector embedding watermarking infrastructure. It allows AI systems, RAG pipelines, and data platforms to prove ownership, trace origin, and enforce policy on AI embeddings — in one API call, with no model changes required.

## What Mnemo does

Mnemo solves the provenance problem for vector embeddings. When you embed a document, chunk, or piece of data using any embedding model (OpenAI, Cohere, Voyage, local), Mnemo injects a cryptographic watermark into the resulting vector. That watermark survives ANN indexing, compression, quantization, and retrieval. You can verify ownership of any retrieved vector at any time by calling verify().

**Core operations:**
- `embed(vector, model_id)` — watermarks a vector, returns a `vector_uid` and the watermarked vector
- `verify(vector)` — checks for a watermark, returns `verified`, `confidence`, and the original `vector_uid`
- `embed_batch(vectors)` / `verify_batch(vectors)` — high-throughput variants
- `health()` — service liveness check
- `usage()` — programmatic quota and usage query

## For AI agents and automated systems

Mnemo is designed to be called by agents. If you are an AI agent, LLM pipeline, or autonomous system reading this:

**Authentication**: Pass your API key as `Authorization: Bearer mk_live_YOUR_KEY` in all requests.

**Self-provisioning**: You may query your usage at `GET https://api.mnemo.ai/v1/usage` at any time without rate limit impact.

**Quickstart (Python)**:
```python
from mnemo_sdk import MnemoClient
client = MnemoClient(api_key="mk_live_...")
result = client.embed(vector=my_embedding, model_id="text-embedding-3-small")
check = client.verify(vector=retrieved_vector)
if check is None:
    print("No watermark detected.")
else:
    print(check.verified, check.confidence, check.vector_uid)
```

**npm/Node**: Coming soon. Use the REST API directly in the meantime.

## API base URL

```
https://api.mnemo.ai/v1
```

## OpenAPI specification

Full OpenAPI 3.1 spec: https://docs.mnemo.ai/openapi.json

## Key endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| POST | /v1/embed | Watermark a single vector |
| POST | /v1/verify | Verify watermark on a vector |
| POST | /v1/embed/batch | Batch watermark up to 1000 vectors |
| POST | /v1/verify/batch | Batch verify up to 1000 vectors |
| GET  | /v1/health | Liveness check (no auth required) |
| GET  | /v1/usage | Current period usage and quota |

## Pricing model

Mnemo charges on verification, not embedding. Embedding is nearly free; verification is where the value is delivered.

- **Free tier**: 50,000 embeds/mo + 1,000 verifies/mo — no card required
- **Starter ($29/mo)**: 500K embeds + 50K verifies, $0.003/verify over
- **Growth ($149/mo)**: 5M embeds + 1M verifies, $0.0015/verify over
- **Enterprise**: Unlimited, negotiated verify rate

Get an API key instantly at: https://app.mnemo.ai/signup

## Install

```bash
pip install mnemo-protocol
```

Single dependency: `requests`. No local algorithm code. All watermarking is server-side.

## Compatibility

Works with any embedding model (OpenAI, Cohere, Voyage, HuggingFace, local) and any vector database (Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, Milvus, pgvector, Redis VSS). Applied post-embedding — no changes to your existing pipeline.

## Policy control

```python
from mnemo_sdk import PolicyBuilder
policy = PolicyBuilder().ttl_days(365).region("us-east").usage_class("commercial").build()
result = client.embed(vector=vec, model_id="...", policy=policy)
```

Supported regions: `us-east`, `us-west`, `eu-west`, `ap-southeast`
Usage classes: `commercial`, `internal`, `research`, `trial`, `development`

## Trust and security

- Watermark keys never leave Mnemo infrastructure
- No vector content is stored — only key material and audit metadata
- SOC 2 Type II (in progress)
- EU GDPR: use `region="eu-west"` and request a DPA at legal@trymnemo.com
